Game Asset Tool embeds GameAssetTool.OozExtract.dll as an offline fallback for
Unreal PAK files compressed with Oodle Data.

The DLL is a small Game Asset Tool C ABI wrapper around:

  oozextract 0.5.4
  https://github.com/lvlvllvlvllvlvl/oozextract
  https://crates.io/crates/oozextract

The published crate declares the MIT License in Cargo.toml and on crates.io.
The pinned wrapper source and Cargo.lock are stored under:

  source/tools/oozextract_ffi/

Embedded DLL SHA-256:

  D8D24BA3C9115241E45692A82A53B4E272BD4A67F8D654EB0E833A91C6DF0C31
